# Fixture provenance

Every file under `wav/` must have an entry in `manifest.json` (generated by
`go test ./internal/fixtures -run TestManifest -update`). Fill in `source`, `tool` and `license` by hand, and describe
how the file was produced below, including tool versions and exact commands, so it can be regenerated.

## wav/amen_kick/

Eleven encodings of the same short kick drum sample (mono/stereo; 8/16/24/32-bit; 44.1 to 192 kHz), moved here from
`encoding/wav/data/internal/testdata/amen_kick/` in Oct 2026. Source, tool and license are **unknown**; ask the author.

Known properties (see `manifest.json`):
- The stereo files are dual mono (L == R on every frame), so they cannot reveal channel-order bugs.
- The 32-bit files carry 24-bit content (the low byte is mostly zero).
- `amen_kick_mono_8bit_176400hz.wav` has an odd-sized data chunk (37393 bytes) followed by the RIFF pad byte.
- Every file has a lowercase `junk` chunk between `fmt ` and `data`.

See `CLAUDE.md` §8 for the files that would extend coverage (true stereo, float, extensible, metadata chunks, live
stream captures, FLAC reference vectors).
